source: schema/schema.md + schema/bryt-number-audit.md (Glue catalog; value-checked in dev twin)
phase05: 0.2.0 applies the Phase 0.5 decisions (see ../phase-0.5-decisions.md): (Q8) pins scope to `IN (:authorised_bryt_numbers)`; (R1) loa_activity pins customer-only; (R2) ecoes_activity moved to excluded (deferred, not in MVP allow-list); (R3) customer_id joins cast int->varchar. MVP allow-list = the 9 dev-verified tables.

brytNumber.supply: server-supplied trusted context from the JWT; never taken from the model or user prompt (R10.3, R11)

mpan.note: fixed 13-char string on both sides; joined by equality, no normalisation (dev-verified min=max=13)

effectiveWindow.note: mpan -> bryt_number is many-over-time (change-of-tenancy). An mpan-keyed row belongs to a bryt only for the period that bryt held the supply. Pinning on mpan equality alone leaks other tenants' rows.
effectiveWindow.openEnded: a NULL or empty supply_end_date means the supply is still current (treat as +infinity)

bindParams.:authorised_bryt_numbers: the signed-in user's Authorised_Bryt_Numbers set (one or more; trusted, server-supplied). Pins use `IN (:authorised_bryt_numbers)`; single-account selection passes a one-element list that must be a member (Phase 0.5 Q8, R10.6).

pins.note: Phase 0.5 (R1): the Customer Portal signs in customers, so the pin is customer-only on customer_bryt_number. tpi_bryt_number is a non-pinning content column. If TPI logins are ever added, add a role-based tpi pin + a table-specific verifier rule then.

pins.joinPredicate: consumption_activity.mpan = supply_mpan.mpan AND consumption_activity.date >= supply_mpan.supply_start_date AND (supply_mpan.supply_end_date IS NULL OR consumption_activity.date <= supply_mpan.supply_end_date)
pins.note: Must be joined to supply_mpan with the effective-date window. An unjoined SELECT MUST be rejected by the verifier (R11/R13).

pins.joinPredicate: meter_reading_activity.mpan = supply_mpan.mpan AND date(meter_reading_activity.reading_date) >= supply_mpan.supply_start_date AND (supply_mpan.supply_end_date IS NULL OR date(meter_reading_activity.reading_date) <= supply_mpan.supply_end_date)
pins.note: reading_date is a timestamp; cast to date for the window comparison.

pins.joinPredicate: sm_consumption_activity.mpan = supply_mpan.mpan AND sm_consumption_activity.date_only >= supply_mpan.supply_start_date AND (supply_mpan.supply_end_date IS NULL OR sm_consumption_activity.date_only <= supply_mpan.supply_end_date)
pins.note: date_only is a date column; date_time (timestamp) is the finer-grained alternative.

mappings.name: supply_mpan
mappings.purpose: Authoritative (bryt_number, mpan, effective-window) mapping used to pin every mpan-keyed table.
mappings.definition: SELECT s.bryt_number, sup.mpan, sup.supply_start_date, sup.supply_end_date FROM supply_activity s CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.supplies) AS t(sup)
mappings.cardinalityNote: mpan -> bryt is many-over-time. In dev, 1,338 (mpan, bryt) pairs over 1,323 distinct mpans (7 mpans map to >1 bryt via CoT). The window columns are mandatory in every pin that uses this mapping.

alternativeSource.reason: Deeper double-nesting; supply_activity (single-level supplies[]) is preferred as the mapping source.

joins.predicate: account_activity.bryt_number = supply_activity.bryt_number AND CAST(supply_activity.customer_id AS varchar) = account_activity.customer_id
joins.note: Phase 0.5 (R3): account_activity.customer_id is string, supply_activity.customer_id is int — cast the int side to varchar so auto-join emits valid Athena SQL.

financial_activity has no account_id; linked via bryt_number + customer_id. Phase 0.5 (R3): apply the same int->varchar customer_id cast as account__supply if financial_activity.customer_id is int — confirm the type at design time.

Linked via bryt_number + customer_id. Phase 0.5 (R3): apply the same int->varchar customer_id cast as account__supply if statement_of_account_activity.customer_id is int — confirm the type at design time.
Structurally similar billing tables; join is plausible but not value-verified. Prefer narrowing by mpan.
The customer side of a Letter of Authority.
The TPI side of an LOA (the intermediary's own account). Only relevant to a TPI login.
Content join on metering point. Does NOT by itself establish the bryt pin — both sides still require the supply_mpan pin join.
Content join on metering point. Still requires the supply_mpan pin join on both sides.
Content join on metering point + meter serial. Still requires the supply_mpan pin join on both sides.

excluded.reason: Phase 0.5 (R2): DEFERRED from the MVP allow-list. Not present in the dev twin (pin schema-verified only, never value-checked) and it is a per-mpan snapshot with no single per-row event date, so the effective-date window that protects the other via-mpan tables cannot be applied per row. Fail closed. Re-admit when (a) a scoped prod Lake Formation grant allows value verification and (b) an as-of anchor is agreed — candidate: master_record_created_datetime resolved against the supply window containing it. Pin shape when promoted: via-mpan on mpan_core (alt queried_mpan) through supply_mpan.
Internal Jira ops data (249 cols). No bryt_number, no mpan, no customer key — cannot be safely pinned to a customer (R18.2).
Internal Jira changelog data. No customer key — cannot be safely pinned to a customer (R18.2).
A _view_test table (Task 0.1). Treat as a candidate, not allow-listed. Same via-mpan pin shape as consumption_activity (mpan col 27, date col 4) if it is ever promoted.
